Theme

Household, washing & chores

laundry noun

clothes to be washed

also washing, dirty laundry, dirty clothes, wash (the washing)

classical

Traupman 338, 404
Laberius ap. Gell. 16.7.5: lavandāria dīcit, quae ad lavandum sint data (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 117

lavandāria, lavandāriōrum n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

laundry, things to be washed

Examples

  • vestīmenta sordida

    dirty clothescomposed

  • vestīmenta munda

    clean clothescomposed

  • vestīmenta lavāre

    wash clothescomposed

  • Vestēs sordidās hīc pōne.

    Put the dirty clothes here.composed

  • Vestīmenta sordida cum lavandāriīs pōne.

    Put your dirty clothes with the washing.composed

See also clothes, washing machine, laundry room, hang out the washing, dirty, wash.
